messages:
mira (product): heads-up — Q3 roadmap sync: we need a concise playbook for Dedicated capacity allocation + fallback during customer bursts. customers keep asking for predictable SLAs but we also need graceful degradation for multi-tenant hosts. can we sketch rules today?

raj (eng-runtime): +1. currently we have lane-based reservations + soft-burst pockets, but behavior under cross-customer spikes is fuzzy. proposed rules: 1) honor reservations up to commit, 2) allow controlled burst using 'elastic pockets' with preemption windows, 3) fallback to cheaper model variant if latency SLOs risk being missed.

olivia (sre): agree with ordering. add: eviction should be based on a deterministic score (reservation level, latency impact, recent errors). we should also emit a signal to customers when preemption happens. ops needs a clear alert taxonomy.

jae (sales): customers want clarity in contract language: "burst not guaranteed; best-effort with X-minute notice" isn't enough. can we offer a "burst SLA add-on" for top-tier accounts (higher cost) that guarantees additional p95 throughput for N minutes?

mira (product): that matches what exec asked for. let's define minimum viable offering: - Burst Add-on (paid): guaranteed burst capacity up to Y qps for M minutes with notification. - Default behavior: best-effort elastic pockets + automatic fallback to pinned cheaper model.

sam (eng-platform): rough config snippet for how we might express policies in infra:
```yaml
reserved_pools:
  - name: silver_reserved
    qps: 200
    priority: reserved
elastic_pockets:
  enabled: true
  capacity_percent: 15 # percent of cluster for ephemeral bursts
preemption_policy:
  score_weights:
    reservation: 0.6
    error_rate: 0.3
    latency_impact: 0.1
```

raj (eng-runtime): we should add model-variant fallback rules too, e.g.:
```text
if latency_slo_breach_estimate > 50%: route -> compatible-quantized-v2
else if queue_time > 200ms: try short-prefix-cache-hit path
```

olivia (sre): monitoring/alerts needed: "burst-pocket-utilization" (warn at 70%, critical at 95%), "preemptions/sec", and a customer-facing event feed. Also add a post-incident reconciliation job to record which requests were fallen back vs failed.

jae (sales): for legal: we need clear contract language + metric examples (e.g., p95 latency, max sustained QPS, burst duration). sales can draft customer-facing SLAs if product/law sign off.

mira (product): action items: @raj + @sam draft an internal playbook doc (1 pager + policy examples) by Mon 1779991400, @olivia define alerts and reconciliation plan by Wed 1779991500, @jae draft customer-facing burst add-on language by Fri. I'll consolidate and present at roadmap review.

deploy-bot: deploy event: dedicated-policy-service v2.8.1 rolled to staging at 1779991600 :rocket:

raj (eng-runtime): noted. one open question: should we expose a "burst budget" meter to customers in console (so they can see how much of the elastic pockets they've consumed)? would help transparency.

jae (sales): yes pls — customers want visibility. even a simple counter and last-preemption timestamp will reduce support load.

mira (product): ok add visibility to wishlist. if we can get a small UI/API item into Q3 it will help adoption. closing loop: i'll post the draft playbook here when done. thanks all :seedling:
